fact: The APDP is an independent administrative authority with legal personality, administrative and financial autonomy, eight members, under Book V of Law 2017-20 as amended by Law 2020-35 of 6 January 2021, and sanctions through its plenary.
title: Interview avec Me Luciano Hounkponou, président de l'Autorité de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (APDP)
